seoTitle: Bot Identifier: Who Is Behind This User-Agent?
metaDescription: Name the bot, operator and purpose behind each pasted user-agent string, with robots.txt behaviour and a reminder to verify the source. Free.
intro: Matches user-agent strings against about fifty known bots and AI crawlers.
why:
Logs are full of strings like Mozilla/5.0 AppleWebKit (compatible; GPTBot/1.4). The name tells you who claims to be visiting, and what they claim to do.

Paste user agents, one per line, and get the bot, operator, purpose and robots.txt behaviour. A user-agent is only a claim: anyone can send any string, so verify by IP range or reverse DNS before acting.
howTo: Look up unknown bots in the directory.

faq.a: Yes. It is by name inside the string, and strings can be forged.
They are reported as no known bot.

faq.q: Where does the bot data come from?
faq.a: The same table as the AI crawler directory; rows are marked checked or not verified.

faq.q: How do I verify a bot?
faq.a: Use the IP range checker or the reverse DNS verifier.
